entry.title: New: Resolution 213 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE UNITED STATES FEDERAL HIGHWAY ADMINISTRATION (FHWA) AND/OR THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION, PURSUANT TO HAWAI‘I REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, FOR A GRANT TO THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I

Allows for the receipt of $3,360,000 to be used towards the Smart Intersection Demonstration Project to improve road safety and reduce accidents at high-risk intersections.
